# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is described as a radiant blonde woman. She is seen dressed in silk clothing.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## History

Honora was initially assigned to teach at Delford school. However, she was subsequently employed at her home school, allowing Opal Pettigrew to take the Delford teaching position. While traveling with her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, Honora stopped at the Pale Sands Hotel to pick up Mrs. Pendexter before making a sudden visit to Nell Harcourt at Grey Shutters. Upon arriving, she helped stable her horse alongside Nell and later expressed high esteem for how Nell handled the unexpectedly hectic visit.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 c20 P25](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Regent's alongside Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>
